ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a seven-membered cyclic ketone structure, with a C=O double bond at the top, and the upper-right ring carbon connected to a Cl. There is also a separate OR⁻ component on the left, representing an O-R single bond. The figure has multiple curved arrows and an H label, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows and excluding bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning: Count by groups of non-hydrogen bonds: the seven-membered ring has 7 intraring C-C bonds; the top carbonyl C=O is counted as 1 double-bond connection; there is 1 C-Cl bond on the right; there is 1 O-R bond in OR⁻. Therefore the total is 7 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 10.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure: a cycloheptanone-like ring with seven ring C-C bonds, one C=O double bond at the top, one C-Cl bond, and a separate O-R single bond in OR⁻. Apply the text instruction to ignore arrows and exclude bonds involving hydrogen. Count the non-H bonds by groups: 7 ring bonds + 1 carbonyl bond + 1 C-Cl bond + 1 O-R bond = 10.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中可见一个七元环状酮结构，顶部有一个 C=O 双键，右上侧环碳连接一个 Cl。左侧还有一个分离的 OR⁻ 组分，表示 O-R 单键。图中有多条弯箭头和一个 H 标记，但题目要求忽略箭头，并排除涉及氢的键。

推理：按非氢键分组计数：七元环中有 7 个环内 C-C 键；顶部羰基 C=O 作为 1 个双键连接计数；右侧有 1 个 C-Cl 键；OR⁻ 中有 1 个 O-R 键。因此总数为 7 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 10。
